title: amaryllis minima
intro: Amaryllis minima, commonly known as the small amaryllis or amaryllis parviflora, is a small, flowering plant species that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. The health benefits of Amaryllis minima include its potential to reduce inflammation and act as an antimicrobial agent, which can help in treating various infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anxiolytic and sedative properties, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Amaryllis minima include alkaloids, which have been shown to possess neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties.
